fault_mode: Malformed receive PDUs in selected receive states are retained and their working count prevents orderly qpair error closure.
trigger: Inject malformed or over-limit TCP PDUs while the target is awaiting request, header payload, or payload data.
observation: Connection does not progress to error closure and available PDU capacity declines across repetitions.
recovery: Each failed connection must close in bounded time and subsequent valid connections must retain full service capacity.
